time.expression: O(n^2) integer operations plus n randomized-rounding calls online

space.expression: O(n^2 log q) matrix bits plus O(n log q) bits per fresh perturbation

notes: The integer arithmetic bound excludes offline preparation and fresh perturbation generation. It uses the stronger operator-norm width promise.

extra.width: s >= r(2 s_1(B)+1), r=omega(sqrt(log n)), for spherical covariance
extra.preprocessing: Precompute inverse and perturbations; a fresh perturbation is consumed for each output
extra.output: One sample on L+c; q Z^n contained in L contained in Z^n and c integral
extra.model: P <= n^2 processors: O(n^2/P) integer operations and ceil(n/P) rounding calls each; arithmetic can be modulo q or q^2
